scenario_scope: Intake of Corben Sorenson's Adjudicated Persistence as the owner of the cross-surface transition from transient experience to durable adaptive structure.

cases.decision_rationale: Existing chapters govern evidence, memory, data, policy, procedures, capability fields, readiness, operations, organizations, resources, and recursive improvement separately. None owns the prior decision that determines whether an experience may acquire durable influence, which portfolio of adaptation loci should carry it, or how commitment burden constrains evidence, authority, monitoring, deoptimization, and descendant closure.
evidence_transition_preconditions: claim-specific finite formalization or preregistered LocusBench execution
matched defect-locus controls and complete candidate portfolios
equal-total-cost and persistence-carrying-cost accounting where comparative benefit is claimed
promotion_blockers: conceptual framework and benchmark proposal only
no Adjudicated Persistence implementation or LocusBench result
no independently checked theorem or validated placement oracle
no complete evaluator-independence, reversibility, or descendant-closure result
non_claims: does not make the new chapter a super-owner over locus-specific mechanisms
does not establish universal minimum-persistence optimality
does not authorize learning, persistence, deployment, or recursive self-modification

cases.existing_chapter_id: evidence-states-and-claim-discipline; stable-capability-fields; recursive-self-improvement-boundaries; cognitive-compilation-and-semantic-ir; durable-semantic-memory-and-knowledge-lattices; artifact-graphs-audit-logs-and-replay; human-ai-organizations-delegation-and-accountability; procedural-memory-and-cognitive-loop-closure; readiness-gates-residual-escrow-and-quarantine; benchmark-ratchets-and-anti-goodhart-evidence; governed-operations-incident-command-and-graceful-degradation; policy-optimization-and-learning-from-feedback; data-engines-continual-learning-and-unlearning; resource-economics-and-token-budgets; integrated-reference-architecture
cases.decision_rationale: The new chapter owns cross-surface adjudication, while each existing chapter retains its local implementation, evidence, authority, qualification, operation, cost, or retirement responsibility. Bounded source mappings keep the interface explicit without copying the paper across the manuscript.
required_before_drafting: source note with passage loci and non-claims
source mappings that preserve local owner authority
evidence_transition_preconditions: each stronger local claim must use the owning chapter's formal or empirical lane
source ingestion alone cannot promote any local owner
promotion_blockers: cross-chapter coherence is architectural reasoning, not validation
paper citations are not inherited as local evidence
non_claims: does not merge the existing chapters
does not transfer qualification or authority to the new chapter

validation_boundary: Records one unique chapter boundary plus bounded integrations into existing owners. It does not validate causal attribution, placement quality, commitment ordering, LocusBench, meta-compilation, safety, novelty, or resource advantage.
non_claims: does not claim the supplied manifest proves manuscript truth
does not add implemented Lean proofs or completed experiments
does not authorize training, deployment, release, or claim promotion
